info.title: Grenmet API
info.description: Grenmet API for authenticated administration, human resources, weather products, CAP alerts, and observation registration.

post.description: OAuth2 compatible token login. Returns an access token for future requests.
Authenticate a user, create an opaque persisted session, and mint a short-lived access token.

post.summary: Exchange a session secret for a short-lived access token
post.description: Validate a persisted session and mint a fresh access token for server-side API calls.
Rotate a valid session secret and mint a fresh short-lived access token.
Revoke the current persisted session. This endpoint is idempotent.

post.summary: Revoke every session for the current user
post.description: Invalidate all persisted sessions belonging to the current user.
Test access token.
Password Recovery.
Reset password.
HTML Content for Password Recovery.

get.description: Return users (superuser or user.manage). Uses standard pagination (page, size, total_pages).

post.description: Create a user (superuser or user.manage). Only superusers can create superuser accounts.

400.description: User with this email already exists

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user.

patch.description: Update profile fields for the currently authenticated user.
Change password for the currently authenticated user.

400.description: Current password incorrect or new password unchanged

post.description: Create a new user account without authentication. Public endpoint for user registration.

400.description: User with this email already exists

get.description: Return user by ID. Non-superusers can only fetch themselves.

patch.description: Update a user by ID (superuser or user.manage). Superuser accounts and the is_superuser flag are superuser-only.

delete.description: Delete a user by ID (superuser or user.manage). Superuser accounts can only be deleted by a superuser.

get.description: Returns whether two-factor authentication is enabled for the current account.

post.description: Generate a new TOTP secret and provisioning URI. 2FA is not active until a code is confirmed via /2fa/activate.
Confirms a TOTP code and enables two-factor authentication for the current account.
Disable 2FA after confirming the account password.

get.description: Return roles (superuser only).

post.description: Create a role (superuser only).

get.description: Return a role by ID (superuser only).

patch.description: Update a role's name or description (superuser only).

delete.description: Delete a role (superuser only). Fails while any user still holds the role.

get.description: Return permissions (superuser only).

post.description: Create a permission (superuser only).

get.description: Return a permission by ID (superuser only).
Return role assignments, optionally filtered by user_id (within active user.manage scope).

post.description: Create a user-role assignment (within active user.manage scope).

get.description: Return a role assignment by ID (within active user.manage scope).

patch.description: Update a user-role assignment (within active user.manage scope).

delete.description: Delete a user-role assignment (superuser or user.manage).

post.description: Create a Stripe-hosted Checkout Session for the current user.

get.description: Returns the organisations that the authenticated user can access.
Return all departments, ordered by name. Requires roster.view permission.

post.description: Create a department. Requires user.manage permission.

patch.description: Update a department's name. Requires user.manage permission.

post.description: Create a user's employment record (department, employee number, position). Supervisor or admin only.

get.description: Return a user's employment record (department, status, position) so an admin can review or edit it. Supervisor or admin only.

404.description: User has no employment record, or user not found

patch.description: Update a user's employment record and approval authority. Supervisor or admin only.

404.description: User or employment record not found

get.description: Return active members of a department with their employment details, for roster rows. Requires roster.view permission.
Return the current user's HR profile (identity, employment, address, preferences).

404.description: HR profile not found for this user

patch.description: Update the current user's HR profile (identity, address, preferences).

404.description: HR profile not found for this user

post.description: Create a new workflow template. Requires workflow.template.manage permission.

get.description: List workflow templates, optionally filtered by department_id. Requires workflow.template.view permission.

post.description: Create a step template for a workflow template. Requires workflow.template.manage permission.
Create a new workflow instance from a template. Template must exist.

get.description: Return workflow instances awaiting an action the current user is authorized to take (named co-approver or role-based approver). Requires workflow.instance.view permission.
Return a workflow instance and its step instances. Requires workflow.instance.view permission.

post.description: Submit, approve, reject, return, or cancel a workflow instance. Requires workflow.instance.action and step-level role. May return 400 if workflow state does not allow the action.

400.description: Workflow cannot be submitted or is not pending

404.description: Workflow instance or step not found

403.description: Not allowed to perform this workflow action

get.description: Return the shift catalog for roster assignment. Pass include_inactive=true (requires roster.manage) to include deactivated shift types for management screens.

post.description: Create a shift catalog entry. Requires roster.manage permission.

400.description: A shift with this code exists

patch.description: Update a shift catalog entry; set is_active=false to deactivate it (historical rosters are preserved). Requires roster.manage permission.

get.description: Return roster periods for a department, newest first. Requires roster.view permission.

post.description: Create a new roster period. Requires roster.manage permission.
Create or replace roster assignments for a period. Requires roster.manage permission.

get.description: Return a roster period and its assignments. Requires roster.view permission.

get.summary: List roster assignments for a date range
get.description: Return rostered days between start and end, expanded to concrete local times, for the calendar. scope=me (the default) returns the caller's own assignments and needs no roster permission; scope=department returns the whole department's and requires roster.view. Draft periods are included only for callers with roster.manage. The range is capped at 92 days.

post.description: Parse a name×day grid CSV, match names to department staff, and report unmatched names / invalid codes without importing. Requires roster.manage permission.
Import a name×day grid CSV into a draft roster period (created or reused for the month). Blocked if any name is unmatched or any code invalid. Requires roster.manage permission.

400.description: Grid has unmatched names or invalid codes

post.description: Validate CSV content for roster import. Requires roster.import permission.

400.description: Invalid CSV (e.g. missing header or columns)

post.description: Create roster import job and optionally apply valid rows. Requires roster.import permission.

patch.description: Transition a draft roster period to published. Requires roster.manage permission.
Close a published roster period. Requires roster.manage permission.

400.description: Period not published or already closed

get.description: Return the revision history for a roster period. Requires roster.view permission.

post.description: Add a public holiday. Requires roster.manage permission.

get.description: Return public holidays, optionally filtered by year. Requires roster.view permission.

delete.description: Remove a public holiday. Requires roster.manage permission.

get.description: Return the department's calendar entries overlapping the date range — meetings, training, inspections, visits, maintenance and anything else staff have recorded. The duty roster is a separate layer, read from /hr/rosters/assignments. Requires calendar.view; the range is capped at 92 days. Cancelled entries are omitted unless include_cancelled is set.

post.description: Record anything the department needs on its calendar. Any member of staff may add an entry (calendar.event.create) and may edit or cancel their own; changing someone else's needs calendar.manage. Times are department-local wall clock, matching the roster.

patch.summary: Update or cancel a department calendar event
patch.description: Edit an entry, or set cancelled=true to strike it from the calendar without deleting the record. The author may change their own entry; changing anyone else's requires calendar.manage.

post.description: Create a new timesheet (self or proxy). Policy controls self/proxy submission.

403.description: Self/proxy submission disabled or not allowed for user

patch.description: Submit a draft timesheet (self or proxy). Requires timesheet.submit.self or timesheet.submit.proxy.

403.description: Not allowed (self only for own; proxy not allowed)

patch.description: Approve a submitted timesheet. Requires timesheet.approve and scope over the user.

403.description: Not allowed to approve this timesheet

get.description: Return timesheets for the current user.
Return timesheets for a department. Requires timesheet.read.department permission.
Return hours aggregated by shift code. Owner or user with timesheet.read.department over the owner.

403.description: Not allowed to read this timesheet

get.description: Return a timesheet and its entries. Owner or user with timesheet.read.department over the owner.

403.description: Not allowed to read this timesheet

get.description: Own history or history within active training read/manage grants. Scope is applied before pagination.

post.description: Requires an active hr.training.manage grant for the employee's department. A completion record does not certify competency.

get.description: Scoped employee search for training history. Employees can find themselves; managers can find employees within their active grants.

post.description: Retains history and records an archive reason. Corrections are entered as replacement records.

404.description: Training record not found or inaccessible

get.description: Returns only the authenticated user's saved signature.

put.description: Creates or replaces your private PNG signature. Previously signed documents remain unchanged.

delete.description: Deletes the reusable signature, retaining existing signed documents.

get.description: Lists permanent signed submissions you signed or that concern you.
Returns the original PDF to its signer, subject, or an HR document reader with scope over the subject.

post.description: Create a leave request for the current user. Requires leave.request.create.self permission.
Submit a previously-saved DRAFT leave request, attaching named co-approvers. Requires leave.request.create.self permission and ownership of the request.

patch.description: Update a still-DRAFT leave request in place. Requires leave.request.create.self permission and ownership.

403.description: Not allowed to action this leave request

get.description: Return leave requests for the current user.

post.description: Create an absentee report. Requires absentee.report.create permission.

get.description: List absentee reports (own or by department). Department filter requires absentee.report.read.department.

post.description: Submit a previously-saved DRAFT absentee report, attaching named co-approvers. Requires absentee.report.create permission and ownership of the report.

403.description: Not allowed to submit this absentee report

patch.description: Update a still-DRAFT absentee report in place. Requires absentee.report.create permission and ownership.

delete.description: Delete an own DRAFT absentee report. Requires absentee.report.create permission and ownership.

get.description: Return shift swap requests created by the current user, newest first.

post.description: Create a shift swap request. Requires shift_swap.request.create.self permission.

post.summary: Submit a draft shift swap request
post.description: Submit a previously-saved DRAFT shift swap request, attaching named co-approvers. Requires shift_swap.request.create.self permission and ownership of the request.

post.description: Create a status report with optional personnel entries. Requires status.report.create permission.

get.description: List status reports. Requires status.report.read permission. Optionally filter by department_id.

post.description: Submit a previously-saved DRAFT status report, attaching named co-approvers. Requires status.report.create permission and ownership of the report.

403.description: Not allowed to submit this status report

post.description: Create an airport security parking access application. Requires parking.permit.create permission.

get.description: List parking permits (own or by department). Department filter requires parking.permit.read.department.

post.description: Record decal issuance for a parking permit. Requires parking.permit.issue permission.

Upload a document against a person as multipart/form-data. Requires hr.document.create; filing against another person additionally requires scoped hr.document.manage over them. Only the six launch categories are accepted; confidential categories and form attachments are deferred.

get.description: List documents (own by default). A user_id or department_id filter requires scoped authority over the target. Supervisors see credentials only; scoped document managers see personnel documents. Deferred categories are omitted.

get.summary: List employees available in the document workspace
get.description: Only employees covered by active document read or management assignments are returned. Search and counts are scoped before pagination.
Return a launch-category document within the same scope as document lists.

patch.description: Update correctable metadata. Requires hr.document.manage, or being the uploader of a document on their own record. Management is scoped. Category cannot be changed — re-file the document instead.

get.description: Redirect to a short-lived presigned download URL. The access check runs on every request, so the link cannot be shared as a standing grant.

post.description: Archive a document. Requires scoped hr.document.manage, or being its subject and uploader. HR documents are never hard-deleted; the row and its file are retained.

get.description: Field-level change history, newest first. Visible to anyone who may read the record itself; values of sensitive fields are masked unless the reader holds audit.view_sensitive.

403.description: Not allowed to read this record

404.description: No history is kept for this kind of record

get.description: The signed-in person's in-app notifications, newest first.
Unread in-app notifications for the header badge.

post.description: Marks one of the signed-in person's notifications as read.
Marks every unread notification of the signed-in person as read.

get.description: Which notifications the signed-in person also receives by email.

put.description: Turn email on or off per notification. In-app notifications are always kept; approval requests cannot be muted.

get.description: Every notification with its effective settings for the organisation. Requires notifications.manage.

put.description: Turn a notification on or off, choose extra recipient roles, edit its wording and timings. Requires notifications.manage.

get.description: Returns the latest accessible version of each CAP hazard profile for the current user.

post.summary: Save a CAP hazard profile version

Approves a reviewed CAP hazard profile version so it can be used to create alerts.

post.summary: Draft an alert from a CAP hazard profile
post.description: Creates a new CAP alert draft using the selected hazard profile and supplied event details.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of CAP alerts accessible to the current user, optionally filtered by lifecycle state.

post.summary: Import a CAP alert from a URL or pasted XML
post.description: Fetches or parses CAP XML from the supplied source and creates an alert draft. The endpoint is rate limited.

patch.description: Updates editable fields on a CAP alert before it reaches a terminal publication state.

Runs CAP and domain validation against the selected alert and returns field-level validation results.
Submits a validated CAP alert for the next workflow review step.

Cancels the selected CAP alert and records the supplied workflow reason.
Marks the selected CAP alert as expired and records the supplied workflow reason.

get.description: Returns CAP publication and workflow settings visible to the current user.

get.description: Return configured webhooks, MQTT brokers, and recent job events.
Returns a paginated audit trail for CAP activity, optionally filtered to one alert.
Returns configured external CAP feed sources available to the current user.

post.description: Registers an external CAP feed source for scheduled ingestion.

patch.description: Updates the configuration of an existing external CAP feed source.

delete.summary: Delete an external CAP feed source
delete.description: Deletes an external CAP feed source and stops its scheduled ingestion.

get.description: Returns the public warning feed without requiring authentication.
Returns currently active public CAP alerts. The response is briefly cached for public feed consumers.
Returns all public CAP alerts available through the public feed.
Returns previously published public CAP alerts from the public feed.
Returns one published public CAP alert by its CAP identifier.

get.summary: Get active CAP alerts as GeoJSON
get.description: Returns active Actual public CAP alerts as a GeoJSON feature collection for map clients.
Returns the cached GeoJSON feature collection of active Actual public CAP alerts.

Issue a short-lived download redirect scoped to the environment's wxwatch prefix.

post.summary: Save, publish or withdraw a weather product
post.description: Checks live product access and expected revision; commits the product and actor history atomically.

Five forecast periods selected using the server clock, with source revisions and explicit UTC validity times.
Returns aviation product drafts for the requested product kind and station. Authoring access is required.

Returns a paginated archive search with optional source, product, date-range, and unknown-time filters.

Returns the image and supporting assets associated with one archived weather-image edition.

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: Stable error envelope for documented API failures.

CalendarEventPublic.title: CalendarEventPublic
CalendarEventPublic.description:
A department calendar entry.

`starts_at_local`/`ends_at_local` are ISO-8601 without an offset — the same
department-local wall clock the roster feed uses, so both layers of the
calendar read on one time base. `created_at` is a real timestamp and is UTC.

RosterCalendarEntry.title: RosterCalendarEntry
RosterCalendarEntry.description:
One rostered day for one person, expanded to concrete time.

`starts_at_local`/`ends_at_local` are ISO-8601 **without an offset**: they are
department-local wall-clock times, exactly as the shift catalog records them
and as the printed roster reads. They are deliberately not UtcDateTime — a
05:30 morning shift is 05:30 on the wall in Grenada, and stamping it UTC
would move it four hours. Codes with no clock time (Off, Leave, Vacation,
Study Leave) carry `all_day: true` and no times.
